subtitle: Configure the SMTP host, port, login and sender profile used to send invoice emails, manual emails and future customer notifications.

errors.port_range: SMTP Port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.from_email_invalid: From Email must be a valid email address.
errors.username_spaces: SMTP Username cannot start or end with a space.

preset_applied: {name} preset applied. Enter the username, password and From Email, then Save.
server_login_help: Enter the SMTP details from your hosting/mail provider here. The password field stays masked.
sender_profile_help: The sender name/email that customers or suppliers see when they receive an email.
invoice_template_help: The subject and body template are used when sending an invoice PDF. Placeholders: {invoice_no}, {total}, {paid}, {due}, {invoice_link}.
presets_help: Selecting a common SMTP provider fills in host/port/encryption automatically.
important_note: For Gmail/Google Workspace, use an App Password, not your normal password. On the production server, confirm that SMTP permission is enabled by your mail provider.
used_by_system_note: These settings are used by the invoice email and manual email flows, because the backend communication service reads the same SMTP keys.
